data.body: **[P2] Opaque values can still bypass the lane byte budget.** Objects such as `functools.partial` or generators can retain arbitrarily large referents outside `__dict__` and slots, while container subclasses can override iteration to hide their elements. They are admitted as small and then retained as opaque leaves by `_copy_record_containers`, allowing a blocked lane to exceed 16 MB substantially. Traverse safely discoverable hidden referents or reject unsupported opaque values, and add a custom-renderable regression covering one of these wrappers.
